question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Gullible
solution:
The correct answer is "**Naive.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **Gullible means easily fooled or deceived.**(भोला)

 
 
• Example: She is a gullible little girl.
 
 
 
• Naive is a synonym of gullible, which means lacking experience, wisdom, or judgmen
